name: io.github.maple-kit/maple
title: Maple
description: Review comments pinned to a running frontend, read and resolved by your coding agent.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A token that can read and write the repository's pull request comments. Required for the github store.

environmentVariables.name: MAPLE_GITHUB_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: The repository's owner. Required for the github store.

environmentVariables.name: MAPLE_GITHUB_REPO
environmentVariables.description: The repository. Required for the github store.

environmentVariables.name: MAPLE_STORE
environmentVariables.description: github, the default when a forge is configured, or file, the comments under .maple/ on this machine.
